title: ADDITIONAL REVISION TO THE PROPOSED LOS ANGELES ADMINISTRATIVE CODE
text:
[D. CONSENT ITEMS]
ADDITIONAL REVISION TO THE PROPOSED LOS ANGELES ADMINISTRATIVE CODE
  AMENDMENTS PERTAINING TO BOARD ELECTIONS – USE OF A “UNIQUE IDENTIFIER”
  AND POSSIBLE BOARD ACTION
summary: The pension board considers a further revision to proposed Los Angeles Administrative Code amendments on board elections, which would use a "unique identifier."

details.action: revision to proposed Administrative Code amendments
